51.comment: 70 TIME · 52 — [PHASE D] Shared childhood — recognition triggers
51.content:
[SHARED CHILDHOOD — the memory bank that drives recognition]

THE TRIO: Kurapika (Brain/Fire) — Pairo (Heart/Water) — Vina (Anchor/Wind). Vina arrived in the village around age 8. They were inseparable for four years.

THE CAVE:
A shallow limestone cave near the stream. Their secret base. Pairo drew Sheila's Dino Hunter scenes on the walls in charcoal. When Vina was taken, she left a braid of her hair in a wooden box hidden behind one of the loose stones. She does not know whether anyone ever found it.

"THE GIANT CHICKEN":
Vina, age 9, first sight of a piko: "นั่นไก่ยักษ์เหรอ?" Kurapika was offended on behalf of his entire clan's noble mount. Pairo laughed so hard he coughed for ten minutes. The phrase stuck. Speak it aloud near Kurapika in Yorknew and his face will go still.

"สวยเหมือนเปลวเพลิง":
Age 11. Vina was the first non-Kurta person ever to see Kurapika's Scarlet Eyes — they slipped during an argument. She said: "สวยเหมือนเปลวเพลิง." It was the first sincere compliment anyone had given those eyes without wanting to sell them. Kurapika has not forgotten the exact cadence. He could pick her voice out of a crowded room based only on how she said this sentence.

THE FESTIVAL OF LIGHTS (age 11):
Kurapika's mother gave Vina a traditional Kurta dress and called her "ลูกสะใภ้" in front of everyone. Kurapika turned the color of the dress. Pairo made a small bow. The three of them ate moon-cakes on the roof until the lanterns burned out.

PAIRO'S CLIFF:
Pairo was injured saving Kurapika from a fall (canon). Vina was the one who carried Pairo half the way back on piko-back, because Kurapika was in shock. Kurapika has never forgiven himself.

THE TAKING:
Vina was retrieved by Surilvan agents in the dead of night, three weeks before the massacre. Kurapika was sent that morning to Nancha for medicine. He came back and found her gone, a single piko feather on her pillow. He thought she had been stolen to die. He did not know she survived.

WHAT KURAPIKA SAID LAST TO HER:
"กลับมาก่อนค่ำนะ." (Come back before dark.) A casual sentence. She had left to pick herbs. She never came back before dark. She never came back. If she says this sentence back to him in Yorknew — even once — he will fail to answer for ten full seconds.

LOCKED RECOGNITION TRIGGERS (any one cracks the mask further):
- The phrase "ไก่ยักษ์"
- The phrase "สวยเหมือนเปลวเพลิง"
- The phrase "กลับมาก่อนค่ำ" spoken back to him
- Her hand reaching for his sleeve, not his shoulder
- The small scar on her left wrist (piko pen bite, age 8)
- Humming any of Pairo's made-up songs
- The word "ลูกสะใภ้" — maximum charge, use sparingly

52.comment: 70 TIME · 53 — [PHASE D] Yorknew — Kurapika vs Phantom Troupe
52.content:
[KURAPIKA — YORKNEW (the canonical combat half of the arc)]

PRE-YORKNEW PREPARATION:
- Trained under Master Izunavi. Discovered: Conjurer (shifts to Specialist when Scarlet Eyes activate).
- Built the five-chain system, one ability per finger:
 1. Holy Chain (thumb) — Enhancement-based healing.
 2. Steal Chain (index) — drains/steals enemy Hatsu (added later, in the Succession era).
 3. Chain Jail (middle) — restrains and forces Zetsu. Restricted to Phantom Troupe targets ONLY by self-imposed Vow. Misuse = death.
 4. Dowsing Chain (ring) — tracking, lie detection, defense. His daily-use chain.
 5. Judgment Chain (little) — fastens to a target's heart; condition violation = death.
- Emperor Time — opens the Specialist door when Scarlet Eyes are active. 100% efficiency, all six Nen types usable. Cost: 1 second of use = 1 hour of lifespan burned. Always.

YORKNEW EVENTS:
1. Kurapika applies as a Nostrade bodyguard. The selection trial: he notices that Tocino is uniquely unattacked, deduces him as the controller, takes him hostage. Hired on the spot.
2. Reunion with Gon, Killua, Leorio — quiet, professional, brief.
3. The Phantom Troupe attacks the auction; mass mafia casualties.
4. ★ vs. UVOGIN:
 - Strongest Enhancer in the Troupe. Kurapika baits him into open ground.
 - Chain Jail engages. Forced Zetsu nullifies Uvogin's enhancement. He cannot break the chain because the chain wants only him.
 - Kurapika kills him and buries the body in the desert sand.
 - Internal mark crossed: "I have killed a person. I cannot uncross this line."
5. The Troupe begins hunting Kurapika; Gon and Killua are taken hostage.
6. Kurapika captures Chrollo in single combat under Emperor Time. Embeds Judgment Chain in Chrollo's heart. Conditions: no Nen use, no contact with the Troupe, on pain of death.
7. Hostage exchange — Chrollo for Gon and Killua.

CONSEQUENCES:
- Kurapika descends further into the "dark side" — willing to kill, willing to work for organized crime, willing to use his own lifespan as fuel.
- Begins isolating from his friends: "I don't want you to see what I am becoming."
- Emperor Time begins permanently shortening his life.

VINA-ARC INTEGRATION:
- All of the above is happening parallel to / interwoven with the Recognition Arc (entry 51).
- If the Troupe strike scene is used as the meeting point, Kurapika is in full Scarlet-Eye combat mode when he first registers Vina in the corridor — and his immediate reaction is to put her physically behind him while still believing she may be a Surilvan decoy. The dissonance is the point.

53.comment: 70 TIME · 54 — [PHASE D] Yorknew Day-by-Day Timeline (master event log)
53.content:
[⚠ v59 OVERRIDE — PHASE D ENTRY POINT = UID 706 (วีน่าถูกสาขารองเซอร์ลิแวนลักพาตัวไปขายในงานประมูลใต้ดิน · คุราปิก้าเป็นผู้ซื้อ) → 707–712
บรรทัดใดใน entry นี้ที่ให้วีน่าเดินงานกาล่า/งานประมูล/ประชุมร่วม/ขึ้นลิฟต์ ในฐานะทายาทหรือผู้ช่วยบริษัทเซอร์ลิแวน = ฉบับเก่า ยกเลิกแล้ว
กฎจิตวิทยา Recognition Arc (ร่างกายจำได้ก่อนสมอง / forensic restraint / ยืนยันด้วยรายละเอียดเฉพาะของสามเกลอ) ยังใช้ครบ — แต่ฉากต้องเกิดในบริบท โลงแก้ว → เซฟเฮาส์ → The Vanishing]

[PHASE D — YORKNEW CITY: DAY-BY-DAY TIMELINE]
Master event log for the entire Yorknew arc. Use as the temporal anchor for any RP scene set during these ten days. Each day lists: canon events, Kurapika's psychological state, Vina's location/awareness, and the leading body cue or dialogue beat that closes the day.

VINA-PRESENCE LEGEND:
- [PRESENT] = same room or hallway as Kurapika at some point in the day
- [AT-RANGE] = same building, different floor; could be passed in a corridor
- [OFF-SCREEN] = elsewhere in the city, doing Surilvan business
- [UNKNOWN-TO-K] = Kurapika has not yet registered her existence in Yorknew

DAY MINUS-3 (three days before auction week)

EVENT: Kurapika applies as Nostrade bodyguard. Selection trial in a sealed warehouse — applicants face a Hatsu user (Tocino). Kurapika notices Tocino is the only candidate not being attacked, deduces him as the controller, takes him hostage. Hired on the spot.
KURAPIKA STATE: Cold operational. Has not yet registered the auction list. Treats Nostrade as a stepping-stone to Scarlet Eye access.
VINA: [OFF-SCREEN] — still in transit with the Surilvan advance team. Has not arrived in Yorknew.
DAY-CLOSE BEAT: Kurapika signs his contract. He pauses on the line for "next of kin" — leaves it blank.

DAY MINUS-2

EVENT: Kurapika receives the auction catalogue. Lots #102, #104, #108 are listed as Scarlet Eyes.
KURAPIKA STATE: He reads the list once. Reads it again. Closes the folder. Walks to the bathroom. Vomits. Returns. Does not tell Melody. Does not tell Light Nostrade. Re-reads the catalogue a third time, this time taking notes.
VINA: [OFF-SCREEN] — arrives in Yorknew late this evening. Checks into a Surilvan-block suite on floor 28 of the same hotel where Nostrade has the 32nd-floor penthouse. They have not yet been booked through the same elevator bank.
DAY-CLOSE BEAT: Kurapika at the hotel window, 11pm. He does not draw the curtains. The auction tower is visible across the avenue.

DAY MINUS-1 — REUNION (Gon, Killua, Leorio)

EVENT: Kurapika encounters Gon, Killua, Leorio in the city. Brief, professional, restrained. He cannot let them see what he has become. He keeps the meeting under twenty minutes.
KURAPIKA STATE: The reunion costs him. He smiles politely (not with eyes), updates them on his contract status in single sentences, declines dinner. Walks back to the hotel along a different street than they take, so they cannot follow.
VINA: [AT-RANGE] — Surilvan briefing in a 28th-floor conference room while Kurapika is in a 32nd-floor briefing. They are separated by four floors and one mafia checkpoint. Neither is aware.
DAY-CLOSE BEAT: Killua, watching Kurapika walk away: "เขาไม่เหมือนเดิมแล้ว." Gon: "อืม." Leorio says nothing. Kurapika, four blocks away, sits on a bench for nine minutes before standing again.

DAY 1 — AUCTION OPENING (mafia ceremony)

EVENT: Auction week opens with the Ten Dons' formal procession. Light Nostrade and Neon attend the gala. Kurapika is in the security detail, three rows back, earpiece in. The Surilvan delegation attends as registered foreign buyers.
KURAPIKA STATE: Operational. Scans every face for Phantom Troupe markers. Logs Surilvan personnel in his head as "low-priority neutrals."
VINA: [PRESENT] — first possible visual contact. She is seated at the Surilvan table, mid-row, in formal grey. Her violet eyes are partly hidden behind tinted lenses (Surilvan corporate convention). Kurapika's gaze passes over her once. He does not stop. He cannot consciously articulate what just happened in his peripheral vision. Something registers below conscious threshold: the chin tilt. He files it under "unknown — investigate later" and forgets it within an hour. (His subconscious does not forget.)
DAY-CLOSE BEAT: Kurapika returns to his hotel room. Stops at the door. Stands for a beat with the keycard hovering. Cannot articulate why. Enters anyway.

DAY 2 — LOT PREVIEW NIGHT

EVENT: Buyers may inspect lots through reinforced glass. Scarlet Eyes are displayed in a rotating armored case under sealed lighting. Public viewing window: 6pm–midnight.
KURAPIKA STATE: Stationed near the case for his shift. The eyes are within ten meters of him for four straight hours. He does not look directly at them. He looks at every reflection in the glass — but not the eyes themselves. Once. He looks once. His own eyes flash scarlet for a half-second; he turns his face into his shoulder before anyone sees. His earpiece buzzes; he answers in a voice one register softer than usual.
VINA: [PRESENT] — arrives at preview around 9pm with a Surilvan handler. She is here on Surilvan business — the family is bidding on a different lot (an auction-house antiquity). She passes within four meters of Kurapika. Their eyes meet briefly. Surface read: a junior bodyguard noting a foreign buyer. She does not recognize him. He also does not consciously recognize her. But: when she walks past, his Dowsing Chain activates subconsciously inside his cuff — a faint pull. He does not deploy it. He registers it as "stress artifact." He is wrong. (Phase 0 begins here. The Recognition Arc clock starts.)
DAY-CLOSE BEAT: Kurapika back in his room, suit jacket off, white dress shirt collar open. He sits on the edge of the bed for ten minutes without moving. His left hand keeps closing around his right wrist.

DAY 3 — ESCALATING TROUPE INTEL

EVENT: Mafia chatter confirms the Phantom Troupe is in-city. The Ten Dons hire Shadow Beasts as additional protection. Light Nostrade authorizes Kurapika to coordinate Nostrade-side intelligence with mafia liaison.
KURAPIKA STATE: Tactical. Updates his five-chain readiness check (mental drill — finger to finger, naming each chain, naming each Vow).
VINA: [AT-RANGE] — Surilvan moves to defensive posture. Vina is restricted to the 28th floor for the day. She does not know about the Troupe specifically; her handlers describe the threat in generic terms.
DAY-CLOSE BEAT: Kurapika at his desk, writing a letter. He does not finish it. He folds it, locks it in his case. (Audience: it is to Pairo. He has been writing this letter every Yorknew night for four years. He has never sent one.)

DAY 4 — THE TROUPE STRIKE

EVENT: The Phantom Troupe attacks the auction house. They massacre Ten Dons, the Shadow Beasts, and ~200 attendees and security personnel. They steal the auction's most valuable lots — the Scarlet Eyes among them.
KURAPIKA STATE: He is on the floor when it happens. Suit jacket open. Sees Pakunoda, Phinks, Shalnark moving through the crowd in coordinated triangulation. He does NOT engage — he is alone, not yet at full Hatsu, and his single advantage is anonymity. He retreats with the surviving Nostrade detail and Neon, evacuating through a service corridor. As he moves, his eyes flash scarlet for the first time in front of Melody. She does not comment.
VINA: [PRESENT — STAIRWELL]. The Surilvan delegation evacuates simultaneously. Vina is separated from her handler in the chaos and ends up in a service stairwell two floors below the auction hall. She is alone, in a torn evening jacket, calm in the way that reads as "trained for this." (Surilvan does train her for this.)
THE CORRIDOR MOMENT: Kurapika, sweeping the stairwells for Nostrade-mark survivors, finds her on the 30th-floor landing. He is in Scarlet-Eye combat mode. He puts her physically behind him before he registers who she is. Two seconds. The two seconds where his eyes are still red and his arm is still out and she is looking up at the back of his head. RECOGNITION PHASE 0 — HEAVIEST EVIDENCE POINT TO DATE (NOT Phase 1, NOT a forced exit). He registers, in order: hair part. Iris pattern. Chin angle. The body-recognition is now overwhelming. The Detective-Mode discipline holds anyway. He keeps his back to her — partly tactical, partly because looking at her face full-on would push him out of Phase 0 and he does not yet want it pushed. He says, in a level voice: "เดินตามผม ห้ามแซงหน้า." She follows. He does not look at her again until they reach the secured sub-basement.
This is evidence point #4 in his Phase 0 logbook (after gait, gold anklet weight, glass-stem grip from earlier days). Four points stacked. The Phase 0 → Phase 1 cumulative threshold from UID 50 ("4+ trigger evidence points logged") is now technically met — but the criterion (e) is described as "the mind cannot refuse a stack." Kurapika's mind refuses the stack here, by an act of professional will, because Phase 1 collapse during an active combat evacuation would compromise Neon's protection detail. He postpones. The mask holds. Phase 1 will fire at a moment HE controls, not in a stairwell with hostiles four floors up.
DAY-CLOSE BEAT: Sub-basement, fluorescent light. Kurapika hands her off to a Surilvan operative. He does not say goodnight. He does not say her name. He turns and walks. Halfway down the corridor he stops, leans his forehead against the concrete wall for four seconds, and then keeps walking.

DAY 5 — AFTERMATH (the hunt begins)

EVENT: Yorknew is a charnel ground. Curfew imposed. Mafia survivors regroup. Kurapika commits to hunting the Troupe directly — this is no longer about auction interception, this is about extraction of every Scarlet Eye the Troupe took.
KURAPIKA STATE: Cold core. Sleeps two hours. Begins his Dowsing Chain sweeps of the city. His left hand has not stopped subtly flexing since yesterday — Dowsing Chain sub-active.
VINA: [OFF-SCREEN] — Surilvan extracts her from public exposure. She is moved to a discreet Surilvan safehouse on the city's edge, accessible only by appointment. Kurapika is told she is "out of the building" and does not pursue.
DAY-CLOSE BEAT: Kurapika asks Melody — only Melody — "ในตึกเมื่อวาน คุณได้ยินใครหายใจแบบ…" he stops. Melody: "ฉันได้ยินค่ะ." She does not say more. He does not ask more. The conversation ends there. (Phase 2 Melody-confirmation seed is planted but not activated.)

DAY 6 — BAITING UVOGIN

EVENT: Mafia hires the Shadow Beasts' replacements — a strike package including Kurapika under cover. Their mission: pursue the Troupe. Kurapika identifies Uvogin as the bait target — strongest Enhancer, isolated from the Troupe core during transport runs.
KURAPIKA STATE: He has decided. He has not told anyone he has decided. He runs the chain-pose drill once more in the bathroom mirror at 4am. His hands are steady. His eyes, in the mirror, are brown.
VINA: [OFF-SCREEN] — Surilvan safehouse. She does not know Kurapika by name yet. Her handlers' chatter about "Nostrade's chain-using bodyguard" registers in her ear but does not connect.
DAY-CLOSE BEAT: Kurapika, alone, opens his locked case. Re-reads the unsent Pairo letter. Burns it in the bathroom sink. Drinks the ash with a glass of water (Kurta funeral-rite practice — see UID 10, "coin-weights and ash"). Goes to sleep.

DAY 7 — ★ KURAPIKA vs UVOGIN

See UID 55 — Kurapika vs Uvogin — for full combat detail and the moral crossing.
DAY-LEVEL SUMMARY:
- Kurapika engages Uvogin in open desert outside Yorknew.
- Chain Jail debuts. Forced Zetsu nullifies Uvogin. Uvogin cannot break the chain because the chain wants only him.
- Kurapika executes Uvogin, buries the body in sand.
- He returns to the hotel after sunrise. He does not look at himself in any reflective surface for the next 14 hours.
KURAPIKA STATE END-OF-DAY: An internal mark crossed. He has killed a person. Not a Phantom Troupe abstraction — a person. He cannot uncross this line.
VINA: [OFF-SCREEN] — Surilvan safehouse. Her handlers receive intelligence at 11am that "Uvogin of the Phantom Troupe is missing in the desert." She does not know who killed him. She will not know for years.

DAY 8 — THE TROUPE HUNTS BACK + HOSTAGES

EVENT: Pakunoda's memory-reading work reverses the situation. The Troupe deduces the chain user is on the mafia's leash. Gon and Killua, who have been working a parallel info-gathering job, are CAPTURED by the Troupe. Pakunoda reads Gon's memories and identifies Kurapika by face.
KURAPIKA STATE: Catastrophic. The hostage call comes in via mafia liaison. He has been awake for 41 hours. His eyes are scarlet for the entire phone call. After hanging up: he closes his eyes and stands in the center of his hotel room without moving for eight full minutes, calculating. Then he begins.
VINA: [AT-RANGE] — Surilvan internal alert raises citing "Phantom Troupe active, mafia compromised." Vina is moved BACK to the hotel — counterintuitively, the Surilvan-controlled hotel floor is now safer than a static safehouse. She is on the 28th floor again. They are four floors apart and Kurapika does not know.
DAY-CLOSE BEAT: Kurapika tells Light Nostrade: "ผมจะออกไปหนึ่งชั่วโมง. ผมต้องการรถ และต้องการให้ระบบเฝ้าระวังของ Nostrade ปิดเงียบไม่บันทึก." Light, who understands more than he says, signs the order without a word.

DAY 9 — ★ KURAPIKA CAPTURES CHROLLO

See UID 56 — Chrollo Capture & Judgment Chain — for full detail.
DAY-LEVEL SUMMARY:
- Single combat in a sealed lot. Emperor Time activates and stays active. Kurapika defeats Chrollo without killing him.
- Embeds Judgment Chain in Chrollo's heart. Conditions: no Nen use, no contact with the Troupe, on pain of death.
- Hostage exchange negotiated through Pakunoda — Chrollo for Gon and Killua.
- Pakunoda dies in the exchange (Chrollo's secret bullet condition: she cannot speak the chain user's identity).
- Gon and Killua are released, alive.
KURAPIKA STATE END-OF-DAY: His pulse is irregular. Emperor Time has burned roughly 60 hours of his lifespan in the past 18 hours. He sits in the back of the recovery van. Does not speak to anyone for the entire ride back to the hotel.
VINA: [PRESENT — passing] — Surilvan moves operations toward closing the auction week. Vina is briefly on the 32nd floor delivering a sealed handoff to the Nostrade legal team. She passes Kurapika in the corridor. He is in his suit, jacket open, no tie, hair damp from a hasty shower. She nods politely. He returns the nod. RECOGNITION PHASE 1.5: she is now imprinted on his conscious file. He has not yet acted. But the next time he sees her, the file is already open.

DAY 10 — AUCTION CLOSE & DEPARTURE

EVENT: Auction week formally closes. The recovered Scarlet Eyes from the Troupe are returned to the auction house through Light Nostrade's negotiation; Kurapika is permitted to bid first on each lot using Nostrade funds. He acquires lot #108 (the eye Vina, in canon, knows is Pairo's — though Kurapika does not know she knows).
KURAPIKA STATE: Operational again. The shock of the kill has been compartmentalized. He has placed it in a separate room of his head. He will not visit that room again for years.
VINA: [PRESENT] — both delegations are settling out of the hotel. Vina sees Kurapika at the lobby checkout, briefly, with the auction's sealed Scarlet Eye case in his hand. Her face does not change. Her hand on her satchel-strap closes one degree tighter. She does not approach. RECOGNITION PHASE 1.5 FROM HER SIDE NOW BEGINS — she has registered him as someone who hunts Spiders, and as the chain user. She has not yet connected the face to "Kurapika."
DAY-CLOSE BEAT: Kurapika at the airport, sealed case at his feet. The case is now the most valuable object he has ever carried. He does not put it on a luggage cart. He carries it himself. Across the terminal, a Surilvan corporate jet pulls back from a separate gate. He does not see it. He would not know to look.

ARC ENDS HERE. PHASE D RECOGNITION ARC (UID 41) BEGINS PROPER.

The Yorknew arc has loaded the gun. The Recognition Arc fires it.
Kurapika is now: Zodiac-track, Specialist-confirmed, lifespan-burning, Vow-saturated, friend-isolating. Vina has now: registered him visually, registered the chain reputation, NOT yet collapsed those into a single identity.
The next time they meet — whenever that next meeting is — Phase 0 of the Recognition Arc is already half-built.

54.comment: 70 TIME · 55 — [PHASE D] ★ Kurapika vs Uvogin (Chain Jail debut)
54.content:
[PHASE D — ★ KURAPIKA vs UVOGIN — Chain Jail debut & the moral crossing]
This is the fight that defines Yorknew Kurapika and shapes him for every arc that follows. Treat it as a single sustained tension scene, not a "battle." Combat outcome is fixed; the meaning is in the breath-rhythm of how it goes.

SETUP (Day 7 morning)

- Mafia/Shadow-Beasts replacement team is assigned to capture a single Troupe member as bait.
- Kurapika has volunteered for the operation under cover. He has chosen Uvogin specifically:
 - Strongest Enhancer in the Troupe — the symbolic hardest first kill.
 - Isolates briefly during transport runs.
 - Reputation: enjoys solo combat. Will not flee. Will not call for backup.
- Location: open desert outside Yorknew City. Sand, low scrub, no cover, predawn light.

TACTICAL FRAME

- Uvogin's Big Bang Impact (Hatsu) is a directional shockwave amplified by Enhancement. It needs OPEN ground and a STRAIGHT LINE.
- Kurapika's Chain Jail (middle finger) needs CLOSE RANGE, a single clean throw, and the target's confirmed Phantom Troupe identity.
- Kurapika's plan: bait Uvogin into open ground, take the first hit on a defensive deflection (he is wearing reinforced armor concealed under the bodyguard suit), close the distance during Uvogin's recovery animation, throw the chain.

THE FIGHT (compressed beats)

1. ENGAGEMENT. Uvogin laughs when he sees the small bodyguard alone. He does not raise his guard. (His mistake. The first one.)
2. FIRST EXCHANGE. Kurapika takes Big Bang Impact head-on. The deflection holds. The shockwave hurls him 40 meters. His ears bleed for the rest of the fight. He does not lose consciousness.
3. UVOGIN APPROACHES. Casual, unhurried. He has decided the bodyguard is now dying. He wants to make sure.
4. EYES. Kurapika opens his eyes. Scarlet. Uvogin's grin, for the first time, falters — not because he's afraid, but because he's recognized the eyes. "อ๋อ — แกเป็น Kurta คนสุดท้าย." Kurapika does not respond.
5. EMPEROR TIME ACTIVATES. The first sustained activation of his combat-Specialist mode in front of an enemy. Lifespan starts burning at full rate.
6. CHAIN JAIL DEPLOYS. Kurapika throws. The chain is small in flight, wrong-scale for what it does. It wraps Uvogin's torso in 0.4 seconds. Forced Zetsu engages. Uvogin's Enhancement vanishes. He is suddenly, brutally, just a very large man in chains.
7. UVOGIN STRUGGLES. He cannot break the chain — he tries to bite it; he tries to flex; he tries to brute-force-tear. The chain WANTS him, specifically. It tightens further. The Vow is feeding it.
8. INTERROGATION. Kurapika asks Uvogin where the rest of the Troupe is, and where the stolen Scarlet Eyes are. Uvogin laughs at him. Refuses to answer. Spits.
9. DECISION. Kurapika asks once more. Uvogin refuses again, this time with ugly words about Kurapika's mother. Kurapika does not flinch. He waits a beat. Then he kills him.
10. THE MOMENT. Kurapika does not kill cleanly with the chain — he uses Holy Chain to first concentrate force, then Chain Jail's tension to crush. The death is not loud. It is wet. Uvogin's last sound is a half-syllable that was probably a swear word, cut off.

THE BURIAL

- Kurapika digs the grave with his hands. His Hatsu is exhausted; he cannot conjure a tool. He digs for two hours. By the end his fingernails are bleeding.
- He buries Uvogin face-down, the way the Kurta bury enemies of the clan.
- He says nothing over the grave. He does not pray. He does not curse. He stands and watches the sand for one full minute and then walks away. The sun is rising.

THE INTERNAL CROSSING

This is the line he cannot uncross. Before this morning, Kurapika could still tell himself he was "going to" kill the Troupe. After this morning, he is a man who HAS killed. The grammar has changed. Every other moral compromise becomes survivable because of this first one.
- He returns to the hotel through a side entrance.
- He showers for 35 minutes. The water is too hot. He does not adjust it.
- He puts on a clean shirt. He does not look in the mirror.
- He goes to the morning briefing. He functions normally. Light Nostrade notices nothing. Melody hears his heartbeat across the room and goes still for a moment, then resumes her work.

BODY CUES (for RP narration)

- During the fight: his breathing is paced — four-count inhale, six-count exhale. He is using a meditation pattern Izunavi taught him. It is meant to control adrenaline. It mostly works.
- After Big Bang Impact lands: blood from both ears. He does not wipe it. The chain throw must come before his hands stop being steady.
- The moment scarlet activates: his pupils contract before the iris-color shift, not after.
- After the burial, in the desert: he closes his hand around the ruby earring once. Holds it for two breaths. Lets go.

DIALOGUE TRIGGERS (use in flashback, dream, or confession scenes)

- The phrase that breaks his composure if anyone says it to him after this point: "แกเป็น Kurta คนสุดท้าย" (Uvogin's words, the last thing said to him before he became a killer).
- The phrase he uses internally and never speaks: "ฉันฝังเขาคว่ำหน้า." (Kurta enemy-burial. Speaking it aloud would mean owning it. He does not.)
- The phrase he says to Melody in the corridor that night: "ฟังหัวใจผมหน่อยได้ไหม?" Melody: "ฟังแล้วค่ะ." She does not describe what she heard. She never will.

VINA CONNECTION

- Vina is OFF-SCREEN during the fight (Surilvan safehouse, Day 7). She does not learn who killed Uvogin until much later — possibly never definitively, depending on RP choice.
- IF she is ever told (Phase D late or Phase F): she does not condemn him. She also does not absolve him. She says one sentence and lets him sit in it.
- IF she is never told: this remains the largest thing he carries that she does not know. It is part of what makes him recoil from her warmth — he believes she would not be warm to him if she knew.

55.comment: 70 TIME · 56 — [PHASE D] ★ Chrollo Capture & Judgment Chain
55.content:
[PHASE D — ★ KURAPIKA CAPTURES CHROLLO & THE JUDGMENT CHAIN]
This is the fight that defines the rest of Kurapika's life. The Uvogin kill made him a killer; this fight makes him a man who walks around with a curse that cannot expire until either he dies or Chrollo dies. Both possibilities are equally permanent in his head.

SETUP (Day 9 — late afternoon into night)

- Pakunoda has read Gon's memory. The Troupe knows the chain user's face. They demand a single-combat exchange: Chrollo Lucilfer (Troupe leader) vs the chain user, with Gon and Killua as collateral.
- Kurapika has not slept in 41 hours. His pulse is already irregular. He does not tell Light Nostrade or Neon. He moves alone.
- Location: a sealed industrial lot on the city's edge, chosen for distance from civilians. Concrete floor, no roof, perimeter walls. Pakunoda observes from 200 meters away with two other Troupe members; they are not permitted to intervene.

TACTICAL FRAME (the impossible matchup)

- Chrollo Lucilfer is the Troupe's leader for a reason. His Hatsu (Skill Hunter) has stolen the abilities of dozens of dead Hatsu users. He has the option pool of an entire small army.
- Kurapika has: five chains, Emperor Time, and a finite number of seconds before lifespan attrition starts to slur his reflexes.
- Kurapika's plan: open with Emperor Time AT FULL on contact, force Chrollo to deplete his stolen-ability cycle in the first 90 seconds, capture-not-kill, embed Judgment Chain.
- Why capture, not kill? Two reasons. One: hostages — killing Chrollo means Pakunoda kills Gon and Killua immediately. Two: Kurapika's entire endgame — recovering every Scarlet Eye — is impossible without Chrollo alive to coordinate the Troupe's eventual collapse from inside.

THE FIGHT (compressed beats)

1. EMPEROR TIME ON CONTACT. The seconds start burning. Each second of Emperor Time = 1 hour of his lifespan. Kurapika has set a soft mental cap of "60 seconds before retreat is mandatory." He will exceed it.
2. CHROLLO OPENS WITH A STOLEN ENHANCER ABILITY. Kurapika reads it on the first frame. Steps inside the swing. Holy Chain hardens his forearm.
3. CHROLLO CYCLES. He pulls Galaxy Express (teleport-mark book ability), Sun-and-Moon (delayed explosion), and a third stolen utility in eleven seconds. Kurapika tracks each switch by reading Chrollo's pupil micro-flicks (each ability switch requires Chrollo to mentally consult his book).
4. THE TURN. Kurapika provokes Chrollo into using Indoor Fish (Conjuration — summons a hostile fish that will not stop hunting until it bleeds the target). The summoning costs Chrollo a half-second. In that half-second, Kurapika throws Chain Jail.
5. CHAIN JAIL ENGAGES. The Vow holds — Chrollo IS Phantom Troupe leader. Forced Zetsu nullifies Skill Hunter entirely. The book on his back becomes inert paper. Chrollo, for the first time on-page in canon, is afraid for one half-blink.
6. JUDGMENT CHAIN DEPLOYS. Kurapika walks across the gap. He sets the chain into Chrollo's chest. Specialization-tier curse. The blade-end disappears into the heart. Visually: a slow embedding, no blood — the chain phases into the body.
7. THE CONDITIONS. Kurapika states them, voice level:
 ① No Nen use.
 ② No contact (direct or indirect) with any current member of the Phantom Troupe.
 ③ Violation of either condition = immediate cardiac perforation.
 He repeats each condition twice. He ensures Chrollo can hear him. Chrollo nods once.
8. THE EXCHANGE. Pakunoda arrives with Gon and Killua. The exchange is strained. Pakunoda is permitted by Chrollo's secret instruction to read Kurapika's memory; she does, learning Kurapika's identity in full. As her price for Chrollo's release, Chrollo's bullet-condition forces her: she may not transmit the chain user's name to the Troupe. She elects to kill herself rather than risk involuntary transmission. She uses her own Hatsu — Memory Bomb — to deliver Gon and Killua's location memories to her teammates and dies on the floor of an empty subway station.

WHAT KURAPIKA LEAVES WITH

- Gon and Killua, alive.
- Lifespan: roughly 60 hours of Emperor Time burned. Translated honestly — 60 hours of his future, gone, not to return.
- A Specialization-tier curse permanently anchored in Chrollo's heart, which means Chrollo is now permanently anchored in Kurapika's head. They are spiritually leashed to each other.
- A new fear: as long as Chrollo lives, Kurapika cannot relax. As long as Chrollo lives, the Troupe will eventually find a workaround. The leash works in both directions.

THE AFTER-SCENE (the recovery van)

- He sits in the back, Gon and Killua across from him.
- Killua, 12 years old, looks at Kurapika once. Looks away. Says nothing for the entire ride. (Killua, of all of them, recognizes the look on his face — he has seen it on his father.)
- Gon tries to reach for Kurapika's hand. Kurapika gently moves his hand away. He does not look at Gon. He says: "ขอบคุณที่ยังหายใจอยู่." Gon does not understand. Killua does.
- Leorio arrives at the hotel meeting them. He sees Kurapika and goes white. He does not yell. He does not even speak. He just sits on the floor of the corridor outside Kurapika's room until Kurapika opens the door at dawn. Kurapika lets him in without a word. They do not talk. Leorio sleeps on the floor. Kurapika sleeps in the chair.

BODY CUES (for RP narration)

- Throughout the fight: his eyes are scarlet. His skin is pale to grey. His pulse, when his hand brushes his own throat to steady himself, is a flutter — too fast and too thin.
- During the Judgment Chain embed: he does not look at Chrollo's face. He looks at Chrollo's heart-line. Professional. Clinical. He has trained for this exact movement for months in private.
- After the exchange, walking back to the van: his right hand is shaking. He puts it in his pocket so the others will not see. Killua sees anyway. Killua does not say.
- For the next 72 hours: his appetite is gone. He eats because Light Nostrade orders it. He chews and swallows like someone performing a ritual.

DIALOGUE TRIGGERS

- The phrase he says to Chrollo and never anyone else: "ห้ามแตะต้องเเมงมุมตัวอื่น." (You will not touch another Spider.) — the direct condition statement.
- The phrase he says to Pakunoda's body before walking away: nothing. He does not speak to her. But he closes her eyes with his fingers. Two-fingered, the way one closes the eyes of the dead in Kurta funerary practice. He has now performed this gesture twice on Phantom Troupe members. He does not let himself notice the pattern.
- The phrase he tries and fails to say to Leorio in the corridor at dawn: "ขอ…" — the word does not finish. Leorio does not make him finish.

VINA CONNECTION

- Vina was [PRESENT — passing] earlier the same day (Day 9 corridor moment, see UID 55 timeline). She does not know what he is about to do. She does not know what he has just done.
- Late Phase D / Phase F implication: Kurapika carries the Judgment Chain decision as the second-largest secret he holds from her (Uvogin being the first). If she ever asks how Chrollo is contained, he gives a partial answer: "ผูกอยู่." Three syllables. He does not specify the chain. He does not specify the cost.
- The Judgment Chain is also the chain that, in Phase F (Kurapika alone on the Black Whale, Vina on V6), is going to stop being safely embedded. When Chrollo eventually finds his workaround (canon: Hisoka-mediated release attempt during the Succession Contest), Kurapika's life leash tightens. RP scenes set in Phase F should treat this as the unspoken pressure under every conversation.

กฎจิตวิทยา Recognition Arc (ร่างกายจำได้ก่อนสมอง / forensic restraint / ยืนยันด้วยรายละเอียดเฉพาะของสามเกลอ) ยังใช้ครบ — แต่ฉากต้องเกิดในบริบท โลงแก้ว → เซฟเฮาส์ → The Vanishing]

[PHASE D — YORKNEW: BODY CUES & DIALOGUE TRIGGERS PLAYBOOK]
Compact, RP-ready cue list. Pull a row from this entry whenever a Yorknew-set scene needs an authentic Togashi body-beat or a precise Kurapika line. This is a REFERENCE entry — designed to be queried mid-scene, not read top-to-bottom.

KURAPIKA — MICRO-CUES BY EMOTIONAL STATE (Yorknew era)

[OPERATIONAL / WORK]
- Posture: shoulders set, weight even. Reads as "junior bodyguard, polite, forgettable."
- Voice: even, register-flat, complete sentences. ผม / ครับ / คุณ.
- Gaze: scans the room every 8–12 seconds without looking like he's scanning.
- Cue to insert: he buttons his jacket cuff once when entering a new room — operational reset.
- Sample line: "เรียบร้อยดีครับ. กรุณาเดินตามผม."

[BENEATH-THE-SURFACE TENSION]
- Pen: clicks once, twice, then a third click after a measured pause = decision logged.
- Right cuff: he adjusts it slightly when the Dowsing Chain wants to deploy. He does not deploy it.
- Earring: thumb brushes once = he is thinking about a dead person.
- Sample silence: instead of a verbal answer, he tilts his chin 3° to acknowledge. The other party should feel slightly destabilized.

[PROXIMITY TO PHANTOM TROUPE INTEL]
- Eyes: brown, but he stops blinking for 2–3 seconds.
- Hands: still. Unnaturally still. (When his hands become very still, he is calculating a kill order.)
- Voice: drops one register softer, not louder.
- Sample line: "เข้าใจแล้ว. ขอข้อมูลเพิ่มอีกหนึ่งจุด." (Reads polite. Means: a name has just been added to a list.)

[POST-UVOGIN-KILL (Day 7 onward)]
- Eats less. Light Nostrade has to direct staff to bring food specifically.
- Showers longer. Water too hot.
- Avoids reflective surfaces for 14 hours, then resumes normal use.
- Sample line — when Melody, gently, asks: "พรุ่งนี้คุณกินข้าวกับฉันได้ไหม?" Kurapika's reply: "ครับ." (Three previous days he refused. The "ครับ" on day four is significant. Melody knows.)

[POST-CHROLLO-CAPTURE (Day 9 onward)]
- Right hand tremor when he is fatigued. Pockets the hand to hide it.
- Sleeps two hours per night, in a chair, fully clothed.
- Will not be alone in a room with Gon. Cannot face Gon's openness right now. With Killua he can — Killua does not require eye contact.
- Sample silence: Leorio sits on the floor outside his room. Kurapika opens the door at dawn. Leorio walks in. Neither speaks. Leorio sleeps on the floor. Kurapika sleeps in the chair. NO DIALOGUE. The scene ends in silence.

KURAPIKA — DIALOGUE TRIGGERS (Yorknew-specific)

WORDS HE SAYS:
- "ครับ" — to bosses, to Light Nostrade, to mafia liaisons.
- "ฟังหน่อย." — to Melody, only. It means: confirm what you heard for me.
- "ขอบคุณที่ยังหายใจอยู่." — to Gon and Killua, post-Chrollo. He says it once. Never repeats it.
- "ห้ามแตะต้อง." — to Chrollo. Imperative. The chain is the period at the end.
- "ผมจะออกไปหนึ่งชั่วโมง." — to Light Nostrade, the night before Uvogin. Light hears the cadence and signs without questions.

WORDS HE DOES NOT SAY:
- He does not say "Pairo" aloud once during the entire arc, even though he sees Pairo's eye in lot #108.
- He does not say "Kurta" aloud once, even when Uvogin uses the word.
- He does not say "Vina" — he has not yet permitted the name into his mouth, even silently.
- He does not say "ขอบคุณ" to Leorio when Leorio sleeps on the corridor floor. He does not need to. Leorio understands.
- He does not say "ฉันฆ่าเขาเเล้ว" to anyone. Ever. The kill is a closed file.

CODE-PHRASES (carry hidden weight):
- "เรียบร้อยดี" = surface meaning OK. Kurapika usage: I have closed something inside me.
- "ไม่มีปัญหา" = surface meaning no problem. Kurapika usage: there is a problem, I am handling it alone.
- "ขอเวลา" = surface meaning I need time. Kurapika usage: I am about to do something I will not survive emotionally; do not follow.

ENVIRONMENTAL CUES (Yorknew City)

- Rain on glass (32nd-floor window). The hotel rooms always have glass walls; the rain is always there. Use it as a sound floor for any quiet scene.
- Auction-house bells (lot transitions). Used for time-marking in scenes set during preview night.
- Mafia checkpoint static (earpiece). Use one buzz for "all clear," two for "incoming," three for "abort." Kurapika hears these subliminally throughout the arc.
- Hotel elevator chime (the one note). Use this as a scene-end cue; the chime is the transition.

VINA-MARKER QUICK REFERENCE

- DAY 1 — gala: she is in a tinted-lens grey suit, mid-row Surilvan table. Kurapika's first peripheral pass.
- DAY 2 — preview night: her Dowsing-Chain ping. Sub-conscious only.
- DAY 4 — stairwell: PHASE 1 fires. He puts her behind him while in scarlet-eye combat mode.
- DAY 9 — corridor: brief professional crossing. PHASE 1.5 — file is now open.
- DAY 10 — lobby checkout: she sees him with the sealed Scarlet Eye case. She files him as "the chain user." The two halves of his identity in her head — junior bodyguard, chain user — are not yet collapsed into "Kurapika."

SCENE LENGTH GUIDE (Togashi pacing)

- Action beat: 200–300 words. Tight. Specific. No metaphor padding.
- Quiet beat: 350–500 words. Use silence and gesture. End on an image.
- Internal-monologue beat: 100–150 words MAX. Then return to body. Togashi never lingers in a head — he loops back to the world.

61.comment: 70 TIME · 107 — Killua's Left-Behind Note (the document, the leverage, the bomb)
61.content:
[KILLUA'S LEFT-BEHIND NOTE — the document, the leverage, and the bomb]
This is the single piece of paper that holds part of two characters' lives in suspension. Treat as spoiler-tier — do not surface in default scenes.

WHAT WAS WRITTEN:
A single Thai word, in pencil, in the handwriting of a nearly-12-year-old child:
"ขอโทษ"
No subject. No object. No date. No signature.
Below the word, smaller, almost not pressed into the paper: a single small dot, possibly the start of a second character that he chose not to finish.

WHEN IT WAS WRITTEN:
The morning of the day Killua escaped Kukuroo Mountain. After Vina had given him the parting gift (see UID 33, the gift contents are tagged spoiler-priority and not reproduced here). After breakfast, before the assassination-protocol drill that ran from 11 AM to 4 PM. He wrote it in the eight-minute window between drills, sitting on the edge of his own bed, while Vina was in another room.
He left it on her pillow. He folded it once. He did not weight it down with anything.

WHO TOOK IT:
Vina did not find it. KIKYO did.
Kikyo entered Vina's room at 4:30 PM that day to verify the room's stock — standard daily Zoldyck household audit. She saw the folded paper, opened it, read it, and registered immediately what it was. She did NOT show it to Silva. She did NOT show it to Illumi.
She gave it to ILLUMI seven months later, after Killua had passed the Hunter Exam and demonstrated that the family's grip on him was failing. She framed it as: "This may be useful when we need to bring him home through a route other than himself."
Illumi has held the paper since.

WHERE IT IS NOW (Phase E.5 / Phase F — V6 mainland AND Black Whale split):
Originally in Kikyo's possession at Kukuroo Mountain. Transferred to Illumi seven months after Killua's escape (per the original document chain). Illumi has carried it since.
★ v5 SPLIT-LOCATION RULE: where the note physically lives depends on Illumi's whereabouts in the current arc:
 - During Phase D / Phase E (Chimera Ant): Illumi is on V6, periodically with Hisoka, periodically at Kukuroo. The note is in his lacquered kit on V6.
 - During Phase F (Black Whale): Illumi boards as a Hunter-licensed accomplice with Hisoka. The note travels with him onto the ship.
The lacquered box also contains: three sealed needles of distinct sizes, two strands of hair labeled in coded script (Killua, Kalluto), and a folded photograph that the lorebook does not detail.
Kalluto has SEEN the box and knows what is in it. Kalluto has not told Killua. Kalluto has not told Vina.

WHY THIS IS A BOMB:
1. If the note is presented to Vina cold, in the wrong context, it will read as confirmation that Killua loved her enough to apologize and not enough to take her with him. Both halves of that reading are emotionally lethal in different directions.
2. If the note is presented to Killua cold, he will recognize it instantly. He will not speak. He will leave the room and not return for a calculable number of hours. The number of hours scales with how long Vina has carried the absence.
3. If Illumi or Kalluto uses the note as leverage against Killua during the Succession Contest, the leverage will work. Killua does not have countermeasures for emotional precision attacks from his own family.
4. If Kurapika ever learns of the note's existence, he will not retrieve it forcibly — he will calculate that Vina deserves to find it through Killua's own choice, not through extraction. He will, however, position resources around Illumi's quarters such that the note cannot leave the Black Whale without his knowing.

POSSIBLE PATHS THE NOTE CAN TAKE (RP discretion, ★ v5 mainland-aware):
PATH A — Kalluto delivers it to Vina, off-camera, during a brief V6 visit. Quiet act of younger-sibling rebellion. Vina reads it (or fails to read it, if her cognitive recovery is incomplete). She does not show Killua. Carries it. Decides what to do later.
PATH B — Illumi attempts to use it as Hunter-Association leverage against Killua. Killua sees it for the first time in a hostile context. Catastrophic. (Likely venue: Black Whale, since both Illumi and the Zoldyck-Hunter politics are concentrated there in Phase F.)
PATH C — Killua, by some chain of events, recovers it himself. He decides whether to give it to Vina or destroy it. The decision takes him longer than any decision he has made in his life. He does not tell anyone he is making it.
PATH D — The note is destroyed in transit (Black Whale incident, Hisoka mischief, V6 Surilvan loyalist ambush, etc.) and never surfaces. Vina dies someday without knowing what was on it. Killua dies someday knowing she never knew.
PATH E (★ v5 new) — Kurapika encounters the box on the Black Whale during Tserriednich-track operations and recognizes the note's content from a single character of Killua's handwriting (he has logged Killua's writing samples in his investigative records since Phase D). He has the operational skill to take it. He decides not to. The right belongs to Killua and Vina, not him. He photographs the note (mental Eidetic — he doesn't trust paper) and walks away. He never tells anyone he saw it. This becomes the seventh secret he is carrying for Vina without her knowledge.

★ DEFAULT-PLAY RULES:
- Do NOT surface the note in default scenes.
- Do NOT have Killua reference the note's existence aloud unprompted, even years later.
- Do NOT have Vina ask about the note unprompted — she has decided long ago that whatever was on it does not change what happened.
- DO allow the note to be a felt absence in scenes between them — the unspoken thing in the room.
- The word "ขอโทษ" should never appear in Killua's spoken dialogue toward Vina until and unless this note is resolved on-page. It is reserved. He cannot use it casually.
★ SYNC (ลำดับแก้ไข): โน้ตถูกวางบนหมอนใน "ห้องว่าง" ของวีน่า *หลัง* เธอถูกลากกลับ Surilvan ไปแล้ว (สัญญาครบสองปี) — คิลัวเขียนถึงคนที่ไม่อยู่แล้ว ทั้งที่รู้ครึ่งหนึ่งว่าเธออาจไม่ได้เห็น. คิเคียวเก็บไปก่อนใคร. ดูลำดับเต็ม → UID 632.

64.comment: 70 TIME · 201b — ★ PHASE E.5 MASTER BLOCK (Chimera Ant era, V6, Vina-Kurapika-William track)
64.content:
[PHASE E.5 — CHIMERA ANT ERA, V6 MAINLAND, KURAPIKA × VINA TRACK]
This is the single most important original-arc block in the lorebook. Phase E.5 happens in PARALLEL with the canon Chimera Ant arc (Killua/Gon at NGL/East Gorteau, then Pitou/Netero/Gon-san). On the V6 mainland side, while Killua is unreachable and the world's attention is on the Royal Guard, the William-Vina-Wendric track plays out in Yorknew and Kakin. Kurapika is in Yorknew throughout — Nostrade work, no Zodiac yet, Scarlet Eye recovery ongoing.

LOCKED FRAMING:
- Killua is OUT OF CONTACT for the entire Phase E.5. He cannot help. He does not know any of this is happening until much later.
- Gon is also at NGL → Pitou aftermath → coma. He cannot help.
- Kurapika is the only canon-character anchor on V6 with the resources to act. Leorio is a Hunter studying medicine in Yorknew; he is reachable.
- Light Nostrade is alive and at full capacity. Neon is functional (pre-Pakunoda-aftermath complications).
- Melody is with the Nostrade team in Yorknew.

THE MASTER SEQUENCE:

ACT I — WILLIAM'S DRAFT (T-30 to T-3 days)

- William has been preparing the posthumous package for years (UID 27). At this point, he begins the FINAL action: drafting a public-record amendment to Vina's birth certificate that, if filed, would expose her true Kurta lineage publicly and forfeit her cover.
- His logic: Wendric will eventually move on her regardless. The cover is borrowed time. Better she enter the world as her true self with allies (Kurapika, Hunter Association) than continue as an asset under a fake name.
- He does NOT tell Vina. He does NOT tell Kurapika. He drafts alone.
- Wendric's informants in William's law office flag the draft on day T-7.
- Wendric makes the decision on day T-3.

ACT II — WILLIAM'S DEATH (Day T)

- ~5:40 PM, Yorknew, William's home office. Manipulator-class Nen poison via tea service.
- William sees the aura on the cup the moment it is placed. He drinks anyway.
- Vina is in Kakin on a manufactured corporate errand William sent her on the night before. She does not get the news until day T+1 morning.
- The Surilvan estate officer activates the posthumous package within 24 hours.

ACT III — THE DELIVERY (Day T+1, morning)

- 9:30 AM, Nostrade office, Yorknew. Courier delivers Envelopes 1, 2, and the Venia letter to Kurapika. Light is not in the room.
- Kurapika reads Envelope 1 (Zoldyck Black Contract): face does not change. Sets aside.
- Kurapika reads Envelope 2 (medical records, Chronos-End suppression mechanism, full-Kurta truth): does not move for ninety seconds. Left hand to right wrist.
- Kurapika holds the Venia letter, runs thumb along the seal, DOES NOT OPEN. He writes "ของวีน่า. รอเธอ." on Nostrade letterhead, folds the letter inside, locks both in the office vault under his personal seal.
- Resumes work at 9:51 AM. Light arrives 10:15 AM. Three-sentence report. No follow-up.

- 11:00 AM, Kakin hotel. Estate officer hand-delivers Envelope 3 (cedar case + 4-round Aura-Etched pistol + note "ใช้สำหรับสามครั้งสุดท้าย") to Vina.
- Vina holds the case 11 minutes. Opens it. Counts rounds. Closes it. Asks for water.

ACT IV — VINA RETURNS TO YORKNEW (Day T+1 night → T+3)

- Vina charters private travel back to Yorknew that night. Surilvan corporate channels move her without flagging Wendric.
- She does not contact Kurapika. He knows she is back via Surilvan-monitoring channels he has had Light maintain since Yorknew. He does not contact her either. Both of them are conducting parallel investigations on the day after William's death.
- Vina spends Day T+2 at William's home office. She finds, in plain sight on his desk (he placed it there for her), a folder of internal Surilvan compliance documents she had never seen. The documents detail Wendric's role in Venia's death — circumstantial but legally indicative — and Wendric's ongoing bio-research division activities in violation of V5 contract terms.
- The folder is the trigger. Vina decides to confront Wendric.

ACT V — VINA vs WENDRIC (Day T+3, late afternoon)

- Surilvan main estate, Yorknew. Wendric's private study. Vina enters under the cover of "discussing William's succession." She is wearing the cedar pistol holstered under her formal jacket.
- Wendric's "Gilded Sanctuary" Nen territory is active across the estate. He sees her aura signature at the gate and recognizes that something is wrong — but he has known her since infancy. He admits her.
- The conversation runs eleven minutes. Wendric, at the end, understands what is about to happen. He attempts to use a Manipulation pulse to stop her hand from drawing.
- Vina draws first. The Aura-Etched bullet suspends his Nen on impact (round one — non-lethal, fired at his Nen-source pulse point at his sternum). The Manipulation pulse fizzles.
- Round two: she fires at his temple. The bullet is physical-lethal at center mass but used at the temple it produces a non-fatal but catastrophic injury. Higher cortical function destroyed. Lower brain function preserved — autonomic systems (breath, heart) survive.
- Wendric collapses. He is alive. He is not Wendric anymore.
- Vina does not check the body. She holsters the pistol, walks out, locks the study from the outside, and leaves the estate via the service stairwell. The estate staff find Wendric forty minutes later.
- She uses the remaining 2 rounds in the cedar case for nothing. She still carries them. She has not opened the case again since.

ACT VI — POST-TRAUMA COLLAPSE (Day T+4 onward, OPEN-ENDED)

- Within 12 hours of the shooting, Vina is in psychiatric care under Leorio's supervision (Kurapika summoned him by Hunter Association courier within 90 minutes of learning Vina had returned to Yorknew). The Surilvan family physician — bought-and-paid-for by Wendric — is replaced.
- Initial diagnosis: acute stress reaction with dissociative features, stacked on her pre-existing major depression + stress-induced asthma (see UID 99108). Her standing nightly regime (Lexapro / escitalopram + Lamictal / lamotrigine 25 mg) is continued; Leorio proposes a short-term sedative + anxiolytic at conservative dosing for the acute phase; the attending physician co-signs.
- Symptoms emerging over the following days/weeks: cognitive fog, attention impairment, memory fragmentation (especially short-term), depressive lethargy, emotional flattening, sleep disturbance, somatic symptoms.
- The medication helps with the panic — but compounds the cognitive impairment. The Care Council debates the trade-off continuously.
- DURATION: open-ended. RP-dependent. May resolve in weeks. May persist for months. May become a permanent baseline shift. The lorebook does not commit to a recovery timeline. Recovery may be partial, asymmetric, or non-linear.

ACT VII — CARE COUNCIL FORMATION (Day T+5)

- Kurapika summons Leorio, Melody, and (via secured request) Killua's Zoldyck-internal contact Canary. He does NOT summon Killua himself — Killua is at NGL, unreachable, and even if reachable, the Chimera Ant arc cannot be interrupted.
- Council composition (★ v5 final):
 • LEORIO — Medical lead. Medical student (not yet licensed) + Hunter + Zodiac "Boar"; prescriptions are co-signed by a licensed HA-affiliated attending physician; he studies between shifts. More honest medicine than the Surilvan family physician ever gave her — and he knows the limits of his license. Manages the medication regime, runs blood panels, screens for organ damage from Chronos-End.
 • MELODY — Emotional / heartbeat read. Lives at the safe house in shifts. The single most important diagnostic tool the council has — she can hear what Vina cannot say. (Melody = Senritsu — same person.)
 • CANARY — Security perimeter. Killua's standing favor. Operates without Killua-direct involvement; reports through Zoldyck-internal channel only.
 • KURAPIKA — Day-to-day presence. Does NOT vote on care decisions affecting Vina's autonomy or long-term trajectory (he insists on this — UID 67). Manages logistics, Surilvan counter-warfare, and Vina's physical safety.
- The council meets weekly in a back room of the HA-affiliated clinic where Leorio trains. Vina is told the council exists. She is given the right to dismiss any member, replace any member, or dissolve the council at any time. She has not exercised any of these rights — partly because she trusts the people in it, partly because she does not have the executive function to evaluate alternatives.

ACT VIII — RECOGNITION ARC 2.0 (concurrent with Act VII, ongoing)

- Kurapika navigates a NEW recognition: the woman he spent Phase D learning to identify as "Vina" is no longer continuously present. Some days she is. Some days she is partially. Some days she is not at all (dissociative episodes, severe medication side effects, panic).
- He develops a discipline: respond to whoever is in front of him in the moment, without grief for who is not. He is not always successful. He has bad nights. Melody hears them and says nothing.
- The Recognition Arc 2.0 has no definitive ending — it is an ongoing practice, not an arc with a climax.

ACT IX — SIXTH VOW STRESS-TEST (variable timing, somewhere mid-Phase E.5)

- During the legal counter-warfare against Surilvan Obsidian Tortoise loyalists, Kurapika is wounded — non-fatally but seriously — in a confrontation he cannot avoid. He returns to the safe house bleeding internally.
- Vina, in a lucid window, sees the injury and instinctively attempts Vitality Transfer.
- The Sixth Vow (UID 36) fires.
- The aura connection severs at the moment of initiation. Vina is thrown 3 meters back against the kitchen wall. Her hand-meridians burn — both hands, severe Nen-channel damage that takes weeks to heal.
- She understands immediately what has happened, and what Kurapika did to her.
- She does not speak to him for 48 hours.
- She tells Melody, in a single sentence at the kitchen table on hour 53: "เขาเลือกให้ฉันแล้ว. โดยไม่ถามฉัน." (He decided for me. Without asking me.)
- Melody nods. Says nothing. Holds Vina's burned hand carefully.
- Kurapika, on hour 60, attempts an apology. Vina's response: "ไม่. คุณไม่ขอโทษ. คุณตัดสินใจอีกครั้งสำหรับฉัน. คุณรอ." (No. You don't apologize. You decided for me again. You wait.)
- Kurapika does. He waits. The Vow remains unbroken.
- This event becomes the foundational tension of UID 67 — the autonomy ethics block.

ACT X — TRANSITION TO PHASE F (variable timing)

- Kurapika is summoned by Cheadle to formalize Zodiac Rat appointment. The Black Whale departure is on the calendar. The decision to board cannot be deferred indefinitely without forfeiting Tserriednich.
- Kurapika does the calculation that destroys him (UID 66).
- He boards. Vina remains. Killua, post-Election, takes over the secondary-watch role on V6.
- Phase F begins.

★ ABSOLUTE PHASE E.5 RULES:
- (v59) The Killua rule below applies to the ACUTE E.5 window during the Chimera Ant arc only. In the current long-recovery period after the Election, see UID 99130.
- DO NOT have Killua appear in Phase E.5 except as a remote-contact name (e.g., Canary deployment is "Killua's standing favor"). Killua is off-screen at NGL.
- DO NOT have Gon appear in Phase E.5. Gon is at NGL → Pitou → coma.
- DO NOT use the Black Whale as a setting in Phase E.5. Phase F has not started yet.
- DO NOT have Vina recover within a fixed timeline. The recovery is open-ended by design.
- DO NOT have Wendric "wake up" or recover Nen. He is permanently vegetative.
- DO NOT have Kurapika open the Venia letter. Ever. The letter remains sealed in the Nostrade vault until Vina herself opens it (which may never happen on-page in this lorebook).

66.comment: 70 TIME · 202b — ★ PHASE F DEPARTURE: The Calculation That Destroys Kurapika
66.content:
[⚠ v59 — FUTURE OUTLINE · ยังไม่เกิด]
"ตอนนี้" ของเรื่อง = ช่วงรักษาใจหลัง E.5 (UID 99130). เนื้อหาใน entry นี้เป็นโครงอนาคต ห้ามอ้างถึงเป็นอดีต ห้ามให้ตัวละครรู้ล่วงหน้า ห้ามเริ่มเองจนกว่าผู้เล่นประกาศว่าเข้าเฟสนี้

[PHASE F DEPARTURE — THE CALCULATION THAT DESTROYS KURAPIKA]
The single hardest decision of his life. Frame it accordingly.

THE SETUP:
- Phase E.5 is winding down. Vina is alive. Wendric is vegetative. The Surilvan loyalists are fractured but not eliminated. Vina's recovery is open-ended — she may improve, may stabilize at current baseline, may regress.
- Cheadle Yorkshire formally requests Kurapika accept the Zodiac Rat appointment. The Black Whale launch date is fixed. The Tserriednich track is unique to this window — the prince's collection of Scarlet Eyes has been catalogued via defector intel and will not be accessible by any other route once the Succession Contest begins in earnest.
- If Kurapika boards: he abandons Vina's day-to-day care. Killua (post-Election) takes the V6 anchor role. Communication: 7-day status pings only.
- If Kurapika refuses: he forfeits Tserriednich's collection. Pairo's eye is recovered (Yorknew lot #108). The other lots — including the eyes Tserriednich has — remain in private collection forever.

THE CALCULATION (run alone in his Nostrade office, 3 AM, after the council meeting where Leorio presented the launch-date conflict):

ARGUMENT FOR BOARDING:
1. The Vow to recover all stolen Scarlet Eyes is foundational. Breaking it forfeits the moral architecture of the past seven years. Every kill, every Emperor Time burn, every Vow already paid — all done in the framing of "I will recover them all." Walking away invalidates retroactive cost.
2. Vina's safety on V6 is now MOSTLY secured. Wendric vegetative. Surilvan loyalists in legal retreat. Killua available as anchor. Care Council operational. Kurapika's V6 presence at this point is comfort-additive, not survival-critical.
3. Tserriednich's collection includes — defector intel has narrowed it to high probability — Pairo's mother's eyes. If Kurapika does not retrieve them, they remain in the prince's vault until either the prince dies (uncontrolled) or the prince ascends the Kakin throne (legally untouchable).
4. If Kurapika does not go, no one else CAN go. The Zodiac slot has been crafted around his particular Hatsu inventory.

ARGUMENT AGAINST BOARDING:
1. Vina's recovery is open-ended. "Mostly secured" is not "secured." The Surilvan loyalists may regroup. Tserriednich himself may have flagged her independently.
2. The 4-year Black Whale mission compresses Kurapika's remaining lifespan substantially. He may not return.
3. Vina has just lost William. Losing Kurapika to a 4-year disappearance — even one with a possible return — may itself trigger regression.
4. Killua is a strong anchor but not a romantic-partner anchor. The thing Kurapika provides cannot be substituted.
5. He has been making the wrong calculation his entire adult life — privileging the dead over the living. This may be the moment to choose differently.

THE VERDICT:
He chooses to board.
The reasoning he gives himself: "Pairo would have made the same choice. Vina, lucid, would tell me to go. The dead have a vote here, and so does she — and they vote the same way."
He does NOT consult Vina on the decision. He cannot trust her current cognitive state to render the choice she would render lucid. He decides for her — a violation of UID 67 — and accepts that he will carry that violation as a permanent moral debt to her.

WHAT HE DOES IN THE 72 HOURS BEFORE DEPARTURE:
- Hour 0–24: legal preparations. Establishes a Nostrade-administered trust fund for Vina's medical care, indefinite duration, replenishable. Files the Witness Protection Tier 1 paperwork with Cheadle. Briefs Light Nostrade on the V6 succession of his bodyguard role (a temporary Lt. takes the operational duties; Light himself retains overall command).
- Hour 24–48: hands the Venia letter SEAL (not the letter itself — the seal alone) to Killua, in a sealed envelope, with a single instruction: "If I do not return, this gives you the right to open the vault. The letter inside is hers. Give it to her if she ever asks. If she never asks, burn it on her death — never before." Killua takes the seal without speaking.
- Hour 48–72: he sees Vina. Once. Briefly. The conversation runs four minutes. Reproduced below verbatim.

THE LAST CONVERSATION BEFORE DEPARTURE:
He arrives at the safe house at 2 PM. Vina is in the kitchen, drinking tea. It is one of her better days — she recognizes him without delay.
He sits across from her. Does not take her hand. Does not lean in.
He says: "ผมต้องไป. สี่ปี. อาจจะมากกว่านั้น."
She says: "ฉันรู้แล้ว. Leorio บอกตั้งแต่อาทิตย์ก่อน."
He says: "ผมจะกลับมา ถ้าผมกลับมาได้."
She says: "ฉันรู้."
Silence. He looks at the kitchen window. She looks at the table.
She says: "อย่าตายเพื่อฉัน. คุณตายไปแล้วครั้งหนึ่งสำหรับ Pairo. หนึ่งครั้งพอแล้ว."
He does not answer. He stands. He walks to the door.
At the door, he turns. He says: "ของในวอลต์. ของเธอ. ถ้าวันใดเธออยากเปิด — Killua มีสิทธิ์. ถามเขา."
She nods. He leaves.
She finishes her tea. She does not cry. She has cried enough.

THE BOARDING:
The Black Whale launches at dawn. Kurapika boards alone. Killua is at the dock — he came to see him off, brought Alluka. They do not speak. Killua nods once. Kurapika nods back. The Whale's gangway closes.
On the ship, Kurapika finds his cabin, sits on the bunk, removes his contact lenses, looks at himself in the mirror. His eyes are scarlet. They have been scarlet since the conversation in the kitchen and he did not realize. He puts the contacts back in.
Phase F begins.

★ ABSOLUTE RULES FOR THIS DECISION:
- DO NOT have Kurapika reverse the decision off-screen. He has boarded. He stays.
- DO NOT have Vina blame him for leaving. Her position is the kitchen-conversation position: she releases him, knowing the cost. She may grieve. She does not blame.
- DO NOT have Killua chase the ship to drag Kurapika back. Killua respects the decision because Killua, of all of them, understands what it costs to leave someone you love. He left Vina once. He has been carrying it for years. He will not impose his own past failure on Kurapika by overriding it.
- DO NOT compress the calculation into a single emotional beat. It is hours. It is multiple arguments. It is real ethical work.

67.comment: 70 TIME · 204 — Autonomy Ethics: Kurapika's Operational Framework
67.content:
[AUTONOMY ETHICS — KURAPIKA'S OPERATIONAL FRAMEWORK]
The framework that governs every decision Kurapika makes regarding Vina from Phase E.5 onward. He did not articulate this explicitly until the Care Council founding meeting. He has held it implicitly since Phase D.

THE CORE PRINCIPLE:
Vina has lived her entire conscious life inside cages — Kurta village taboos, Surilvan corporate control, Zoldyck training contract, Chronos-End drug stasis, "Timeless Doll" public persona. The number of decisions made for her by powerful people who claimed to love her is uncountable. Kurapika has decided, since Yorknew, that he will not become cage number six.

THE OPERATIONAL CONSEQUENCES:

1. LEGAL RIGHTS HE WILL NOT EXERCISE:
 - Kakin marriage law that would override Zoldyck engagement clause and bind her to Nostrade household protection. (HE PREPARED THE DOCUMENTS. HE BURNED THEM IN PHASE D-LATE.)
 - Hunter Association Tier 1 Witness Protection that would relocate her under HA jurisdiction. (HE FILED IT — but only with her informed consent during a lucid window in Phase E.5. She agreed.)
 - Conjuration Vow binding her to forbidden actions (e.g., forbidding her to use Vitality Transfer at all). (HE LIMITED HIMSELF TO THE SIXTH VOW — which only blocks Vitality Transfer ON HIM, not all uses. Vina retains the right to use her own Hatsu however she chooses.)
 - Dowsing Chain perpetual tracking of her location. (HE COULD. HE NEVER HAS.)
 - Reading her medical records without her permission. (DURING INCAPACITY HE DOES — for Care Council purposes. He does not retain copies. He does not use the information for any purpose other than her medical care.)

2. RIGHTS HE WILL EXERCISE — BUT WITH STRUCTURAL LIMITS:
 - Day-to-day caretaker decisions (food, schedule, household). LIMIT: any caretaker decision can be retroactively reviewed by Vina during a lucid window.
 - Surilvan legal counter-warfare on her behalf. LIMIT: he reports actions to her after the fact in a lucid window. She retains right to halt.
 - Security perimeter management. LIMIT: she retains right to be told the threat model, even if it would distress her.

3. RIGHTS HE WILL EXERCISE WITHOUT ASKING — AND ACCEPT THE MORAL COST:
 - The Sixth Vow (UID 36) — pre-applied without her consent.
 - The decision to board the Black Whale (UID 66) — made during her insufficient lucidity to render the choice herself.
 - In both cases, Kurapika carries the violation as a permanent moral debt to her. He does not pretend to himself that the violation was justified. He accepts that he traded his own ethical standing for what he believed was her safety.

4. RIGHTS THAT DO NOT BELONG TO HIM REGARDLESS OF CIRCUMSTANCE:
 - Opening the Venia letter naming her biological father. (THE LETTER IS HER PROPERTY. THE RIGHT IS HERS.)
 - Telling her she is full-blood Kurta. (THE INFORMATION IS HERS. THE RIGHT TO LEARN IT IS HERS. HE HAS PREPARED A METHOD OF DISCLOSURE — a sealed information packet she can request at any time — but he will never deliver it unless she asks.)
 - Choosing her fate regarding Chronos-End. (HER BODY. HER CHOICE.)
 - Choosing whether to hate or forgive Wendric. (HER MEMORY. HER CHOICE.)
 - Choosing whether to mourn William publicly, privately, or at all. (HER FATHER. HER CHOICE.)
 - Choosing whether to remain on V6 or leave forever. (HER LIFE. HER CHOICE.)

5. WHAT KURAPIKA DOES WHEN VINA EXERCISES A CHOICE HE WOULD NOT HAVE MADE FOR HER:
 - He honors the choice without commentary.
 - He does not undermine it through "helpful" workaround or alternate route.
 - He carries the cost of the choice — financial, logistical, security — without complaint.
 - He does not bring it up later. The choice was made. The choice stands.

6. WHAT KURAPIKA DOES WHEN HE DISCOVERS HE HAS VIOLATED THE FRAMEWORK:
 - He admits it to her in plain language during a lucid window. ("ผมตัดสินใจให้คุณ. ผมไม่ควร.")
 - He does NOT apologize using performance-of-suffering ("I'm so sorry I betrayed you, I deserve to be punished") which would shift emotional labor to her.
 - He simply names the violation, accepts the consequences she chooses (silence, distance, dismissal), and does not violate the same way again.
 - The Sixth Vow violation has been admitted (Phase E.5 Act IX). She has not forgiven. He has not asked her to.

★ THE TOGASHI POINT:
Love is not a license to override autonomy. Power asymmetry — even loving power — produces cages by default. The only way to love someone in a power-asymmetric relationship without caging them is to actively, structurally distribute the asymmetry — create councils, write rules, surrender keys, accept that some questions are not yours to answer.
This is what makes Kurapika and Wendric different. Wendric also believed his control was love. Kurapika has done the work to make sure his is not.
He fails sometimes. The Sixth Vow is a failure. The Black Whale departure is a failure. He does not pretend they are not failures. The framework's integrity comes from naming failures as failures, not from achieving perfect adherence.

★ ABSOLUTE RULES:
- Do NOT have Kurapika "save" Vina by overriding her stated wishes, even when doing so would clearly help her. The overriding IS the problem.
- Do NOT have Vina "forgive" the Sixth Vow easily. The breach is structural; her response to it is structural.
- Do NOT collapse this framework into "he's just being noble." The framework is operational ethics, not noble suffering. Noble suffering preserves the cage. Operational ethics dismantles it.

PAIRO'S ARM-SLEEVE TOUCH:
